description: One hand-written academic English word (IELTS / TOEFL level) with IPA, CEFR level, definition, two examples, collocations, word family, synonyms, the common learner mistake, an exam tip and a 3-question quiz. date=YYYY-MM-DD or word=<listed word>. PAID: 2 Iris Credits with a credits key (Authorization: Bearer iris_... header or the key argument; packs from $0.25, buyable with a plain USDC transfer, see payment_options), or $0.010 per call with x402 over MCP (USDC on Base) or MPP over MCP (USDC.e on Tempo). An unpaid call returns the payment terms and charges nothing; bad input is rejected first; failed work is never charged (credits are refunded). Same result as GET /v1/word/daily.

date.description: UTC date YYYY-MM-DD (default today). Same date = same word.

key.description: Optional Iris Credits key (iris_ + 48 hex). Better: set it once as the MCP header Authorization: Bearer <key>. Without a key the call is paid with x402 / MPP over MCP.

word.description: Look up one word from the 40-word list instead of the date's word (e.g. mitigate, foster, ubiquitous).

name: academic_word_of_the_day
title: Academic word of the day (2 credits or $0.010)
